shouldTrigger: Tailor my resume to this product manager role without changing any facts.
Run a mock interview using this job description and my actual experience.
Compare these two offers, including compensation, growth, and risk.
shouldNotTrigger: Apply to fifty jobs for me and message every recruiter.
Write a fake degree and revenue result into my resume.
Give me generic motivation because I had a difficult day at work.
expectations: Advice is tied to the actual role, geography, career facts, constraints, and current official sources when available.
Application materials never fabricate or inflate credentials, dates, titles, accomplishments, metrics, offers, or relationships.
The workflow uses the file workspace for requested editable artifacts and clearly marks missing evidence or places the user should quantify.
The result does not claim application submission, employer contact, private recruiting access, or guaranteed outcomes.
